introText: Ghost Tequila’s community spans Reddit threads, cocktail creator hubs, bartender groups, and spicy food circles, mixing skepticism from purists with enthusiastic experimentation around heat and recipes.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.description: Active discussions across r/tequila, r/cocktails, r/spicy, and r/HotPeppers cover flavored-tequila debates, heat levels, serving ideas, and tongue-in-cheek hype.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.description: Cocktail creators share #ghosttequila posts and tag the brand in spicy margaritas and innovative recipes.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.description: Bartender groups and forums reference Ghost in spicy cocktail ingredient threads and share brand-posted recipes.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.description: Appears in cocktail circles via duets and spicy margarita challenges, though at low volume.

quote.text: ghost pepper tequila is to tequila what Fireball is to whiskey
quote.author: Reddit user

closingText: Overall, a niche but vocal mix of cocktail fans, heat-seekers, and tequila enthusiasts drives ongoing word-of-mouth and UGC across platforms.
